test.query: SELECT number % 100 AS k1, toString(cityHash64(number)) AS k2 FROM numbers_mt(20000000) ORDER BY k1, k2 FORMAT Null
SELECT number % 2 AS k1, number % 4 AS k2, number % 8 AS k3, cityHash64(number) AS k4 FROM numbers_mt(20000000) ORDER BY k1, k2, k3, k4 FORMAT Null
SELECT char(65 + number % 26) || toString(cityHash64(number)) AS s FROM numbers_mt(5000000) ORDER BY s COLLATE 'en' FORMAT Null
SELECT toString(cityHash64(number)) AS s FROM numbers_mt(20000000) ORDER BY s FORMAT Null
SELECT toString(cityHash64(number % 1000)) AS s FROM numbers_mt(50000000) ORDER BY s FORMAT Null
